requirements.description: Actual Windows 98 is the final visible OS; VMM, USER, GDI, Win16/Win32 and Explorer execute.
checks: actual Windows 98 started on ShizukuDOS
genuine VMM USER GDI and Explorer identities observed

requirements.description: Source-built ShizukuDOS replaces original Microsoft DOS before WIN.COM/VMM.
checks: original Microsoft DOS absent from boot chain
replacement kernel boot entry and WIN.COM EXEC observed

requirements.description: Real PSP/MCB/SDA/CDS/SFT and INT2F/DOSMGR startup and instance contracts preserve resident lifetime.
checks: actual DOS startup and resident structure contracts verified

requirements.description: Windows VMM owns Windows threads, VM contexts and Win16 lock; backend workers preserve those decisions.
checks: VMM schedules Windows threads
Windows VM and Win16 scheduling authority preserved

requirements.description: Actual VxD caller-bound events signal/wait/timeout/cancel without lost wakeups.
checks: actual asynchronous PMA wait and wake
manual auto-reset timeout cancel and lost-wakeup stress passed

requirements.description: DOS services serialize in original DOS VM/InDOS/error-mode context.
checks: actual DOS executor context
DOS services serialize without nonreentrant overlap

requirements.description: Forced thread/process/VM death and VxD reload fence identities and preserve accepted terminal replies.
checks: actual owner thread process VM and reload rundown passed
no stale completion or identity reuse across epochs

requirements.description: Actual runnable workers preempt, sleep, wake and obey priority and bounded deadlines.
checks: real backend preemption synchronization and deadlines passed

requirements.description: Actual two and four CPU backend runs show concurrent independent work, not CPU flags.
checks: two or more native PMA CPUs execute work
concurrent work progresses on separate CPUs
VMM scheduling authority preserved
two and four CPU native execution passed

requirements.description: Per-CPU stacks/TSS/IRQ/current state, allocator/runqueue locks, reschedule and TLB IPIs are exercised.
checks: actual per-CPU stacks IRQ TSS runqueues and allocator protection passed
actual reschedule migration and TLB shootdown passed

requirements.description: UP boot and AP-start failure preserve BSP progress and Windows compatibility.
checks: actual uniprocessor and failed-AP fallback passed

requirements.description: Native GOP pixels serve Windows USER/GDI and project shell without replacing Windows GUI.
checks: actual native GOP Windows frontend and input passed
GOP framebuffer bounds format pitch and mode fallback verified

requirements.description: High-resolution GOP shell, scaled glyphs, dirty updates and legacy-exit restoration work.
checks: GOP full-screen shell text scaling and restoration passed

requirements.description: On-demand per-session VGA/SVGA/VBE uses trapped compatibility state presented through GOP.
checks: normal DOS text VGA and supported SVGA applications render through GOP
legacy video state stays isolated and unsupported modes reject explicitly

requirements.description: Windows storage/input use actual modern backend and persist file operations after cold boot.
checks: Windows file create flush reopen and independent disk readback passed
actual modern storage and input Windows frontend passed

requirements.description: Existing Win16/Win32 paths and Windows message, GDI and lifecycle semantics regressions pass.
checks: actual legacy Win16 and Win32 applications passed
Windows GUI messages GDI and file IO remain stable

requirements.description: A real Windows app calls NT compatibility API through Shizuku PMA worker and receives the result.
checks: actual Windows application NT wrapper Shizuku worker result roundtrip passed

requirements.description: Versioned shared wrapper ABI handles valid/invalid calls, ownership, cleanup and explicit unsupported results.
checks: versioned wrapper ABI symbol parameter error cleanup and concurrent tests passed
